facts: Parties: Ashcombe Engineering Ltd (Buyer), Corrib Pharma plc (Seller); the Company is Rothley Pharma plc.
This Agreement is dated 23 October 2026; Closing is scheduled for 29 January 2027 (the 'Closing Date').

Section 9.5 (Limitation of Liability): the aggregate liability of the Seller for warranty claims shall not exceed an amount equal to 10% of the Purchase Price, being $20,625,000. The Purchase Price is $165,000,000 (see Section 2.1).
Section 15.1: this Agreement is governed by English law and the courts of England have exclusive jurisdiction.
Section 9.7: the Buyer must notify any warranty claim within 30 days of becoming aware of it.

Section 1.1: 'Material Adverse Change' means any event which has a material adverse effect on the business of the Company, excluding changes in general economic conditions, changes affecting the industry generally, and pandemics.
Clause 12: this escrow agreement is governed by the laws of the State of New York and disputes shall be referred to arbitration in New York.
Clause 5.2: a claim against the Escrow Amount must be notified within 60 days of the Buyer becoming aware of it.
